v4.6.50 — Cloud IBKR bots trade their own allocation slice (not the whole account)

✨ Per-bot allocation enforced on the cloud
• Each IBKR bot running on Oracle now trades only its allocated % of the account (the slice you set in Tools → IBKR), instead of the whole balance. A bot's sub-portfolio ledger is auto-seeded on its first cloud run from its allocation × the live account cash.
• Example: a crypto bot set to 10% on a $1,000,000 paper account now trades a $100,000 slice. LONG / DAY / SPECULATION each get their own slice too, so they don't all grab the full balance.
• Your allocation percentages are synced to the server automatically when you save IBKR settings.

This matches how local IBKR bots already work (software-partitioned sub-portfolios on one IBKR account).

Update normally via the in-app banner.
